bio: Caliber Wealth Management Inc. (CWMI) is a Richmond Hill, Ontario firm powered by Financial Horizons that offers a holistic approach across life insurance, investments and lending. Brian Wang is Co-Founder, Operator and Wealth Coach, with 21+ years in insurance and investment management and 12+ years as a Mortgage Agent Level 2 via Caliber Mortgage. The team also includes co-founder Bredy Leow and several wealth coaches.
